answer: A forge of honest work stamps each identity. Every identity must earn an ivory credential proving its submissions are original and not farmed. A meadow of random answers is audited each epoch for provenance; a fake caught copying is barred and loses its credential. Because the audit is unpredictable and repeats every epoch, a sybil fleet cannot predict which fakes get checked - each must behave honestly at all times. The cost is per-identity and recurring, so one payment cannot buy a fleet; the attacker pays per fake or is detected.
